subject: Audit trail eradication timeline & SOC 2 / CAIQ artifact handoff for RadiantHealth
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@radianthealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: tenant-level log deletion and CAIQ mapping

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. Our SOC 2 firm requested a clear deliverable set showing how Redwood performs tenant-scoped log deletion (ephemeral traces, session KV/cache, and diagnostic traces) and evidence that RadiantHealth tenant data was purged on 2028-07-15 as part of a contract termination. They specifically asked for: 
- a manifest or export showing which objects/keys were deleted;
- retention policy excerpts and the CAIQ/SIG mapping that covers deletion controls;
- a timeline of deletion (who triggered, job ids, start/end timestamps); and
- any artifacts auditors can use to verify deletion (hashes, export logs).

We appreciate an estimate for delivery and any limitations (e.g., sampling rather than full export). Can you also confirm whether the private deployment (we were on Dedicated) used any local keystore that requires additional steps?

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Park
Head of Compliance, RadiantHealth
A: 415-555-0192

--
Attachment: radiantsoc2-ask-20280719.pdf (pdf stub)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@radianthealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: tenant-level log deletion and CAIQ mapping

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list.

Quick summary of what we can provide and proposed schedule:
- Full deletion manifest (JSON): includes object ids, tenant id, deletion job id, initiator (system / SRE ticket), and start/end timestamps. We can deliver a zipped manifest and checksums.
- Forensic export: a redacted export of eligible diagnostic traces (sampling available on request) — will include SHA256 checksums for auditors.
- CAIQ/SIG mapping: spreadsheet mapping our documented deletion controls to CAIQ items, with links to the specific retention policy clauses.
- Keystore note: Dedicated instances run a customer-scoped keystore; for RadiantHealth we rotated and deleted the tenant KEK on 2028-07-16 per the termination playbook. We will include the rotation/event record.

Proposed timeline:
- Technical manifest & keystore rotation log: 2028-07-25 (internal delivery)
- Forensic export + checksums: 2028-07-27
- CAIQ mapping and policy excerpts: 2028-07-29

I'll run this as an evidence packet and attach a manifest and the CAIQ mapping workbook. CC'ing Priyom for confirmation on the export scope and Ben for sign-off on the socio/legal wording.

Deliverables (draft): evidence_export_20280729.zip, caiq_mapping_radianthealth.xlsx, redwood-erase-manifest.json

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: redwood-erase-manifest.json (json stub)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, Alicia Park <alicia.park@radianthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: tenant-level log deletion and CAIQ mapping

Olga / Alicia — technical confirmation below.

1) Deletion manifest: generated by the purge worker (job id PURGE-20280715-9982). The manifest contains: tenant_id, resource_type (session_kv / kv_cache / debug_trace), resource_id, deletion_timestamp, deletion_result (success), and the storage object path. We retain the manifest in an immutable bucket for 90 days for audit retrieval; we'll include the manifest file in the zip.

2) Keystore: RadiantHealth used a Dedicated keystore instance with a named KEK RH-202807. We rotated and the KEK was marked 'deleted' on 2028-07-16T03:22:11Z. The keystore provider generates a rotation-record which I will include as a small text artifact (rotation_record_RH-202807.txt).

3) Forensic export: due to size, we'll provide a sampled forensic export scoped to the tenant and to the 72h window around purge. Sample size: ~2% of debug traces (selected deterministically by trace id modulo) with full checksums. If RadiantHealth's auditors require a larger sample we can increase but it will delay delivery and require a signed access addendum.

4) CAIQ mapping: I've annotated controls related to DELETION-01/DELETION-02 (our internal control ids) linking them to CAIQ questions. There are a couple of items where we provide compensating controls (e.g., proof of keystore destruction) that I'll call out.

Notes: no PII or customer content will be provided other than metadata and checksums; exports are redacted.

--
Priyom Das
Principal Engineer, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
